narrative.intro: Research Triangle Institute obligated $250M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Research Triangle Institute received 289 awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $866K. Obligations are down 30.8% year over year. Fiscal-year totals show a peak of $663M in FY24 and then a decline to $362M in FY25 before the current-year total of $250M. The Department of Health and Human Services is the dominant buyer, obligating $194M so far in FY2026. Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services is the largest market for Research Triangle Institute, with $91.5M in obligations, followed by All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services at $68.6M. Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities accounts for $27.4M. Other notable markets include Other Accounting Services at $19.5M and Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services at $12.2M. The FY2026 picture is concentrated by agency and market, with Health and Human Services and consulting services representing the bulk of obligations.

sections.heading: How much has Research Triangle Institute received so far in FY2026?
sections.body: Research Triangle Institute obligated $250M in FY2026 to date. Research Triangle Institute received 289 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $866K. Obligations are down 30.8% year over year. Fiscal-year history shows FY25 at $362M and FY24 at $663M, indicating the current total is a partial year figure.

sections.heading: Who are the top buyers for Research Triangle Institute in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: The Department of Health and Human Services is the largest buyer at $194M. The Environmental Protection Agency followed at $15.7M, the Department of Labor at $12.9M, and the Agency for International Development at $12.3M. Smaller FY2026 buyers include the Department of Education at $8.4M and the National Science Foundation at $2.3M.

faq.q: How much does Research Triangle Institute make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Research Triangle Institute obligated $250M from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Research Triangle Institute recorded 289 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $866K. Obligations are down 30.8% year over year compared with prior periods, and fiscal-year history shows $663M in FY24 and $362M in FY25.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Research Triangle Institute?
faq.a: The Department of Health and Human Services is the largest buyer of Research Triangle Institute in FY2026 to date at $194M. Other top buyers include the Environmental Protection Agency at $15.7M, the Department of Labor at $12.9M, the Agency for International Development at $12.3M, and the Department of Education at $8.4M.

faq.q: What does Research Triangle Institute sell to the government?
faq.a: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services is the largest market for Research Triangle Institute at $91.5M. Other significant markets include All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services at $68.6M, Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities at $27.4M, and Other Accounting Services at $19.5M.
